name: ColorPicker
note: ColorPicker.framework, prebuilt and embedded in the app (ColorPicker/Makefile builds it in Release). In the migration's scope.

name: CoreParse
note: CoreParse.framework, which the app embeds, is built by the main Makefile from submodules/CoreParse; outside the scope (submodules), captured so that its sends to the app's delegates are parsed. Its project lists no arm64 in VALID_ARCHS (the Makefile passes it), hence the setting.

name: SignedArchive
note: The command line tools of SignedArchive/ (in the scope); the app's own build compiles the SignedArchive framework's files, so that target is not kept.
